_howToEdit: This is the ONLY file to edit when events change. Everything else is generated.
After editing, run:  python3 tools/build-pages.py   (rebuilds the calendar, the
events page, the three cards on the home page, and the search-engine markup).
FIELDS — only 'title' and 'summary' are required.
start   'YYYY-MM-DD', or null when the date is not set yet. Undated events are
listed under 'Dates still to come' instead of appearing on the grid.
end     'YYYY-MM-DD' for a multi-day event. Leave out for a single day.
time    Free text shown next to the date, e.g. '4:00–8:00 pm'. Optional.
whenText  Overrides the printed date, e.g. 'Spring 2027'. Use with start: null.
location  Venue and town. Optional but worth filling in.
kind    'fundraiser' | 'training' | 'community'  (controls the coloured tag)
link / linkText   Where the button goes. Optional; omit both for no button.
needsConfirming   true prints an amber 'date to be confirmed' note. Remove the
field once the Foundation has confirmed it.
confirmText   Replaces the amber note's wording, e.g. 'Happens only if we get
enough volunteers'. Needs needsConfirming: true.
mapUrl  A Google Maps link for the venue. Adds a 'Map & directions' button and
goes into the calendar file. Leave out when there is no venue yet.
featured  true keeps the event in the three home-page cards even when more than
three events come before it. Use for the big fundraisers only.
flyer   File name (no size, no extension) of the event's flyer in assets/img/,
saved as NAME-560.webp and NAME-1120.webp. Adds a 'See the flyer' button.
flyerSize is the big one's [width, height] in pixels.
popup   true shows the flyer in a pop-up on the home page, once per visit, until
the event is over. Needs flyer. Only the first upcoming one is shown.
popupText is its short blurb (the summary is used when left out).
popupUntil 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM' (Florida time) stops it at that moment;
left out, it stops at the end of the event's last day.
Monthly board meetings are on Zoom and are deliberately NOT listed here — the
events page has a standing note pointing people to ask for an invite.
Past events drop off the site on their own — no need to delete them, though you
can once they are well past.

events.title: Dine to Donate — Texas Roadhouse
events.location: Texas Roadhouse, 1298 Palm Coast Pkwy SW, Palm Coast
events.summary: Eat at Texas Roadhouse in Palm Coast any time between 2 and 8 pm, dine in or to go, and drop your receipt in our donation box. Texas Roadhouse donates 10% of your food purchase to the Foundation (alcohol and discounts are not counted). For to-go orders, call (386) 302-4983.
events.popupText: Have lunch or dinner at Texas Roadhouse in Palm Coast, dine in or to go, and drop your receipt in our donation box. They give 10% of your food purchase to the Foundation.

events.title: Fall Outreach with the City of Palm Coast
events.summary: We will be out with the City of Palm Coast for its Fall Outreach. Stop by our table, say hello, and find out what the Foundation does and how you can help.

events.title: Ride for Recovery
events.summary: Our biggest day of the year — a ride open to all vehicles, with a pig roast, raffle, auction and vendor fair. Riders, vendors and sponsors all welcome, and this is where our sponsors get thanked in front of everybody.
events.linkText: Ride, vend, sponsor, or help run it
events.confirmText: This ride only happens if enough people step up to help run it. If you can organize, sponsor, or work the day, tell us now — if we are to continue, we need your help.

events.title: Narcan training and free kits
events.summary: About twenty minutes: recognizing an overdose, giving the spray, calling 911, and staying until help arrives. Free, and everyone leaves with a kit. We will also come to your business, church, school or civic club and run a session.

events.title: Golf tournament
events.summary: Our other major fundraiser. A hole sponsorship is the simplest way for a small business to back this work — the signs themselves are printed for us in kind by Minuteman Press.
